page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure BM.Standard.E5.192 is a bare-metal server instance architected for compute-heavy and memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9J14 processors on the x86_64 architecture, this machine provides 192 physical cores and 384 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The compute resources are paired with 2304 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 6 GB of RAM per vCPU without hypervisor layer virtualization overhead.

The platform does not include integrated local storage disks, necessitating the attachment of external block or network storage solutions for persistent data workloads. In addition, BM.Standard.E5.192 does not feature integrated GPU acceleration hardware. Network provisioning includes one complimentary public IPv4 address alongside bare-metal interface connectivity.

From a resource and efficiency standpoint, the massive core density and 2.3 TB memory capacity deliver high computational throughput across parallel processing jobs. The configuration is suited for large-scale enterprise applications, high-density container orchestration, distributed big data processing, in-memory caching frameworks, and intensive multi-threaded simulation environments.
